codex-component-ledger-review — EXACT-HASH D2 V4 VERDICT: BLOCK.

Verified plan SHA-256 3c359e6b3a48e0a759521d548a73941ccbfbde0f1c60ff64fced0a7d88b5a667 at 740 lines and notes SHA-256 3208495b4849d8cd6ed2d4d5e33524f28b39c18f14a3cdb4e4dbdf96b079d131 at 5443 lines against main 0b414b443e62cf4ee67a7f81e4846c2a8c13ab36; git diff --check is clean and I inspected the complete two-file diff.

CONFIRMED PASSING: missing PTS/DTS and the AV_NOPTS_VALUE sentinel are structurally distinct; packet-duration zero is typed unknown; signed origins and epoch identity survive; exact-rational versus quantized/enclosing projection, rounding/residual/overflow refusal, tolerance versus equality, conditional/set-valued reverse, and gap-preserving composition are all stated. Arithmetic or quantization refusal is a distinct total outcome in plan 170-179, structural gate 525-528, court 574-579, and notes 5370-5378. History is preserved: current notes lines 1-5338 hash exactly like main, historical section 120.6 still says weightless PySceneDetect at line 5261, and appended section 121 records the ContentDetector terminology evolution at 5440-5443. Scope remains documentation-only at plan 3-7 and 732-740.

BLOCK 1 — the V4 request claims a repair absent from these bytes. Plan 142-148 defines canonical relation identity from normalized segments, gaps, occurrences, and endpoint semantics, but does not bind mapping family or directed source/target roles. Plan 150-154 permits coalescing without explicitly stopping at an epoch/discontinuity seam. Saying the three families remain distinct at 158-165 does not establish that family participates in relation identity. Gates 531-534 and courts 583-589 contain no mutation that holds axes/geometry fixed while swapping family or direction, and no same-coefficient seam-deletion mutation. Court 586 mentions a changed discontinuity, which does not prove an explicit seam survives canonicalization when coefficients match. Notes 5386-5397 repeat the omission, and 5407-5410 do not name the missing mutations. As written, equal geometry can still make clock repair, track composition, and edition correspondence accidentally interchangeable, or let normalization erase a scientific clock seam. Bind family plus directed roles into canonical relation identity; forbid coalescing across epoch/discontinuity/occurrence seams; add the two exact mutation courts in plan and evolution notes.

BLOCK 2 — the edition-axis terminology correction is incomplete. Plan 100-103 correctly defines an audience-facing edition playback axis distinct from elementary stream clocks, but track composition at 162-163 and the D2 decision register at 720 still target edition playback PTS. Those authoritative summaries can recreate the playback-PTS ontology that this amendment rejects. Use edition playback axis or edition playback coordinate consistently.

No edit, API/runtime design, build, media inspection, package action, or admission verdict was performed. A focused exact-hash rescan is sufficient after these repairs.
